12:T6529b,<p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526b939-560d-11f0-adf2-6def444ceba7" style="">지난주</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e04a-560d-11f0-adf2-df193accf40b" style="">2025년 기아 타이거즈의 외국인 타자</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e04b-560d-11f0-adf2-83679a639c40" style="">패트릭 위즈덤의 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e04c-560d-11f0-adf2-e96f4c9e6c15" style="">영양가(?) 논쟁이 뜨거웠는데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e04d-560d-11f0-adf2-a3169bf32938" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_0.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e04e-560d-11f0-adf2-83470df3d697" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e04f-560d-11f0-adf2-2544fe1e4b39" style="">이 선수가 기회 때마다 삼진을 당하는 등</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e050-560d-11f0-adf2-a511677091ed" style="">변변한 타구를 만들어내지 못하면서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e051-560d-11f0-adf2-e33346f38d2d" style="">중요할 때 한 방을 쳐내지 못한다는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e052-560d-11f0-adf2-c504a11da98d" style="">비판에 시달리게 되었습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5526e053-560d-11f0-adf2-c9976fcae666" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_1.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55270764-560d-11f0-adf2-9fec255923f5" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55270765-560d-11f0-adf2-c5b19e8f88e9" style="">실제로 결정적인 상황에서 해결사 역할을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55270766-560d-11f0-adf2-dbd872d5c0a0" style="">측정하는 지표인 WPA를 보면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55270767-560d-11f0-adf2-95db9a529f55" style="">위즈덤의 기록은 0.23으로 높지 않습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55270768-560d-11f0-adf2-097fa4267b68" style="">위즈덤의 비교 대상이 될 수밖에 없는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55270769-560d-11f0-adf2-af8bf7c84956" style="">NC의 데이비슨은 이 값이 올해는 1.07</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55272e7a-560d-11f0-adf2-ef17851e8118" style="">작년에는 3.32 였습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55272e7b-560d-11f0-adf2-75de5cc25bf4" style="">차이가 많이 나죠?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55272e7c-560d-11f0-adf2-ed1f17702efb" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55272e7d-560d-11f0-adf2-0ff7033bffba" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://sports.donga.com/sports/article/all/20250626/131891540/1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="고척돔에서 타율 ‘0.091’ 위즈덤 왜 이러나…이범호 감독 “공이 잘 안 보이는 것 같다” [SD 고척 브리핑]"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://sports.donga.com/sports/article/all/20250626/131891540/1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        고척돔에서 타율 ‘0.091’ 위즈덤 왜 이러나…이범호 감독 “공이 잘 안 보이는 것 같다” [SD 고척 브리핑]
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        KIA 타이거즈 패트릭 위즈덤(34)은 ‘고척 포비아’를 이겨낼 수 있을까.위즈덤은 25일까지 고척스카이돔에서 5경기 타율 0.091(22타수 2안타) 3타점으로 부진하다. 그가 KBO리그에서 경험한 9개 구장 중 가장 부진한 공격지표이며 동시에 1할 밑의 타율을 지…
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55272e7e-560d-11f0-adf2-e10f60eeb4fe" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs19 se-ff-" id="SE-5527558f-560d-11f0-adf2-fda2ee151f4a" style=""><b>1. 위즈덤은 돔구장에서 못한다?</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55275590-560d-11f0-adf2-2592d7112c49" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55275591-560d-11f0-adf2-23e3839cadae" style="">특히 지난주 키움과의 고척돔 시리즈에서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55275592-560d-11f0-adf2-893c99594b77" style="">너무 못하니까 별의별 이야기가 다 나왔습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55275593-560d-11f0-adf2-37ba11fc356d" style="">그중 하나가 "위즈덤은 돔에서 못 한다"라는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55275594-560d-11f0-adf2-6dae9ce50ef9" style="">이야기인데요... 사실일까요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55275595-560d-11f0-adf2-e39774e67e83" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">​</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">MLB 통산</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">돔에서 기록</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">.750</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">.889</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">타율</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">.209</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">.261</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527a3bf-560d-11f0-adf2-5fb213782418" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527a3c0-560d-11f0-adf2-4710d669932d" style="">MLB 기록만 보면 그렇지 않습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad1-560d-11f0-adf2-c52c39935b7d" style="">오히려 돔에서 잘 했습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad2-560d-11f0-adf2-371fcb142e4c" style="">특히 타율은 5푼이 더 높았습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad3-560d-11f0-adf2-3343c232a6ea" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_2.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad4-560d-11f0-adf2-1fded21872ab" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad5-560d-11f0-adf2-1f9a77a17331" style="">돔에서 못한다기보다는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad6-560d-11f0-adf2-a128d9c12649" style="">돔을 홈으로 쓰는 키움에게 약하다고 보는 게</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad7-560d-11f0-adf2-f9ac9c36db7c" style="">더 합리적인 판단으로 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad8-560d-11f0-adf2-f15dc35a6147" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_3.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cad9-560d-11f0-adf2-5bcfe6b12c41" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cada-560d-11f0-adf2-4f8bb93d6b33" style="">시즌 초반 광주에서 키움과 만났을 때는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cadb-560d-11f0-adf2-930b2e70eb81" style="">굉장히 잘 했었는데요...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cadc-560d-11f0-adf2-7de2b3b3bca1" style="">그 이후에 허리 부상 공백 그리고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cadd-560d-11f0-adf2-83a1b728726f" style="">원정에서 만난 키움과의 승부는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cade-560d-11f0-adf2-41066f4518f3" style="">형편없는 결과를 만들어 내고 있습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527cadf-560d-11f0-adf2-432781ba8aa4" style="">그리고 하필 그곳이 돔구장이었던 거죠.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f0-560d-11f0-adf2-d3b9f58874be" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f1-560d-11f0-adf2-c9b978713f46" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs19 se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f2-560d-11f0-adf2-f90f53612ccd" style=""><b>2. 위즈덤은 바깥쪽 공에 약하다?</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f3-560d-11f0-adf2-650d61d4758b" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f4-560d-11f0-adf2-e9ebc93ed4dc" style="">위즈덤이 최근 키움에게 약했던 건</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f5-560d-11f0-adf2-ed355d2bda1b" style="">다름 아닌 바깥쪽 공 승부 위주의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f6-560d-11f0-adf2-3740c9f9bd29" style="">투구 패턴 때문으로 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f7-560d-11f0-adf2-1bc55e95e1f1" style="">아래는 지난주 화요일 키움과의 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f8-560d-11f0-adf2-1777c8fb2de6" style="">첫 번째 경기에서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1f9-560d-11f0-adf2-29d889ca032c" style="">위즈덤을 상대한 키움 투수들의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1fa-560d-11f0-adf2-1b49851284fd" style="">투구 위치들인데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5527f1fb-560d-11f0-adf2-b1bd05100ac0" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_4.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_5.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_6.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_7.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528190c-560d-11f0-adf2-fde8bda26d64" style="">위즈덤 타석을 대표하는 2가지 키워드를</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528190d-560d-11f0-adf2-03f90771c4b5" style="">뽑아보라면 바로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528190e-560d-11f0-adf2-fbadbb541e1a" style="">"바깥쪽"과 "슬라이더"입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528190f-560d-11f0-adf2-31024ab89994" style="">이런 패턴은 수요일, 목요일 경기에서도</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281910-560d-11f0-adf2-65ae04dc577d" style="">이어지는데요...</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_8.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281911-560d-11f0-adf2-a91a96e5c9d2" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281912-560d-11f0-adf2-9fe619764f49" style="">실제로 위즈덤의 투구 위치 별 장타율을 보면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281913-560d-11f0-adf2-1b702abe2ab6" style="">바깥쪽이 상대적으로 떨어지는 게 사실입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281914-560d-11f0-adf2-1f17dbe24adc" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_9.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281915-560d-11f0-adf2-5b6a6773ffc6" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281916-560d-11f0-adf2-11b35cf44970" style="">게다가 슬라이더는 더더욱</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281917-560d-11f0-adf2-6d2d8a0ff104" style="">장타율이 떨어진다는 것을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55281918-560d-11f0-adf2-a9edf2e95fc0" style="">확인할 수 있는데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55284029-560d-11f0-adf2-37c2fbca9c98" style="">공교롭게도 올해 위즈덤이 가장 많이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528402a-560d-11f0-adf2-df50eeb7d799" style="">상대한 팀이 바로 키움입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528402b-560d-11f0-adf2-5d4961cbf957" style="">그만큼 상대도 전력분석을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528402c-560d-11f0-adf2-bb833a957ec9" style="">탄탄하게 하고 나왔을 가능성이 높죠.</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">​</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">포심 구종가치</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">슬라이더 구종가치</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">MLB</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">-0.24</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">-0.80</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">KBO</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.4</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">-0.69</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55286746-560d-11f0-adf2-5ba391f6d18a" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55286747-560d-11f0-adf2-9543ba018af6" style="">한 가지 주목할 점은 원래 MLB에서도 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55286748-560d-11f0-adf2-29a5a7cb9688" style="">슬라이더에 약한 선수였다는 점입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55286749-560d-11f0-adf2-6768fe6e7a24" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs19 se-ff-" id="SE-5528674a-560d-11f0-adf2-0f984f194afd" style=""><b>3. 상대가 바깥쪽 슬라이더로</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs19 se-ff-" id="SE-5528674b-560d-11f0-adf2-57c4745aae92" style=""><b>집중 공략하면</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs19 se-ff-" id="SE-5528674c-560d-11f0-adf2-1d2c14b06927" style=""><b>대책 없이 무너질 가능성이 높다?</b></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528674d-560d-11f0-adf2-df6dd6ec014c" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528674e-560d-11f0-adf2-71c30244d936" style="">현재로서는 큰 변화가 없는 한</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528674f-560d-11f0-adf2-05275fee5a26" style="">그럴 가능성이 높아 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55286750-560d-11f0-adf2-5b63b1a00fc7" style="">다만 시간이 지나면서 대응법을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55286751-560d-11f0-adf2-e37700df4e2e" style="">찾아낸다면 이야기는 달라질 수 있습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-55288e62-560d-11f0-adf2-2dd7922c3634" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">​</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">포심 구종가치</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">슬라이더 구종가치</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">MLB</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">-1.27</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">-0.69</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">KBO</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.14</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.25</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b57c-560d-11f0-adf2-2dbcfe44ec91" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b57d-560d-11f0-adf2-bdf2f39ff636" style="">위 기록은 MLB에서와는 다른</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b57e-560d-11f0-adf2-c5e3ba0c821d" style="">구종가치를 보여주고 있는 한 선수의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b57f-560d-11f0-adf2-f9ddc5e0d140" style="">기록인데요. 누굴까요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b580-560d-11f0-adf2-cf6eda075ed8" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_10.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b581-560d-11f0-adf2-033500fe64b6" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b582-560d-11f0-adf2-d59f53ebf8d9" style="">네. 위즈덤의 롤모델 데이비슨의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b583-560d-11f0-adf2-37a84014aaff" style="">기록입니다. 그리고 데이비슨은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b584-560d-11f0-adf2-0d924ad1d93d" style="">바깥쪽 볼도 장타율이 높아요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b585-560d-11f0-adf2-27f5eb6c4d3e" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_11.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528b586-560d-11f0-adf2-13dd56465750" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc97-560d-11f0-adf2-4faf6a56e57b" style="">바깥쪽 슬라이더는 상대적으로 장타율이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc98-560d-11f0-adf2-ab6c69051234" style="">떨어지지만 말이죠...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc99-560d-11f0-adf2-1750e7e82555" style="">예전에도 언급한 적 있지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc9a-560d-11f0-adf2-dd593e78c6b4" style="">데이비슨도 동양야구 첫해인</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc9b-560d-11f0-adf2-05c3eb539b0a" style="">2023년 히로시마에서는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc9c-560d-11f0-adf2-6b92040cfa9c" style="">기록이 좋지 못했습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc9d-560d-11f0-adf2-8ba8b95f0f76" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc9e-560d-11f0-adf2-eb303fdd4a5c" style="">

              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dc9f-560d-11f0-adf2-65fec48dcaee" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dca0-560d-11f0-adf2-a1892a6dfa8a" style="">이 선수가 일본에서 한국으로 넘어오면서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dca1-560d-11f0-adf2-611cfb35d623" style="">기술적으로 업그레이드되었든</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dca2-560d-11f0-adf2-a72dcf5fbd9f" style="">접근법을 바꾸었든</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dca3-560d-11f0-adf2-179c6f3862a5" style="">뭔가 변화를 만들었기 때문에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dca4-560d-11f0-adf2-eff79e898aeb" style="">홈런왕이 되었을 거라고 보는데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5528dca5-560d-11f0-adf2-9d16b26cfb5b" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_12.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903b6-560d-11f0-adf2-e56f3a838376" style="">이건 위즈덤이 슬라이더에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903b7-560d-11f0-adf2-a3ab550704c5" style="">스윙을 하는 비율이고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903b8-560d-11f0-adf2-7fb2e1cf9eba" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_13.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903b9-560d-11f0-adf2-05653abd5d54" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903ba-560d-11f0-adf2-218fc44a0603" style="">이건 데이비슨이 작년에 슬라이더에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903bb-560d-11f0-adf2-a99a12081ceb" style="">스윙을 한 비율입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903bc-560d-11f0-adf2-fd0096d1d537" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_14.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903bd-560d-11f0-adf2-5d0c056c830d" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903be-560d-11f0-adf2-c5789f644a48" style="">이건 그중에서 위즈덤이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903bf-560d-11f0-adf2-790b17d9b24b" style="">타구를 맞춘 비율이구요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903c0-560d-11f0-adf2-bbac140edaf5" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223917326078_15.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903c1-560d-11f0-adf2-b3da03bdb7d7" style="">이건 데이비슨의 작년</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903c2-560d-11f0-adf2-95ce8b957cde" style="">슬라이더 컨텍률입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552903c3-560d-11f0-adf2-41f543b615f7" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929d4-560d-11f0-adf2-13308ebf1a8b" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929d5-560d-11f0-adf2-35b43837cbf4" style="">두 선수의 MLB 통산 컨텍률은 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929d6-560d-11f0-adf2-09561eca19f0" style="">큰 차이가 나지 않습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929d7-560d-11f0-adf2-2ff094b657ba" style="">다만 존 밖에 던져지는 투구에 대한</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929d8-560d-11f0-adf2-efd84f3bcafc" style="">컨텍률은 데이비슨 선수가</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929d9-560d-11f0-adf2-e58757c700ee" style="">10% 이상 높았습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929da-560d-11f0-adf2-17a6d6e38aec" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929db-560d-11f0-adf2-3502dd7047c5" style="">종합해 보면 바깥쪽 슬라이더를</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929dc-560d-11f0-adf2-5b8ac7369adf" style="">굳이 장타를 만들어낼 필요는 없어 보여요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929dd-560d-11f0-adf2-9d16a1c79353" style="">데이비슨도 장타는 별로 없었죠~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929de-560d-11f0-adf2-0f07890cbdff" style="">다만 슬라이더에 대한 적응 여부는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929df-560d-11f0-adf2-9742a90022b3" style="">남은 시즌 위즈덤은 물론</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929e0-560d-11f0-adf2-1141d807b2bb" style="">팀 성적에 있어서도 매우 중요한</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929e1-560d-11f0-adf2-5572959fa768" style="">문제가 될 것으로 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929e2-560d-11f0-adf2-49fe4dbbafc3" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-552929e3-560d-11f0-adf2-dde697d5101a" style="">​</span><br/></p>
